# rota

> rota coordinates parallel coding agents across tasks and accounts, with reviews and configured checks before merging. Start in the user's coding harness with /rota-init, then /rota-orchestrate.

## Start

- [Install instructions for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/l4ci/rota/main/install.md): install the binary and skills with the user's approval
- [Get started](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/getting-started/): initialize the project and run the first parallel round
- [Worker setup](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/first-round/): hosts, tracker access, accounts and merge checks

## Understand

- [How it works](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/how-it-works/): orchestrator, workers and merge checks
- [How changes are checked](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/agent-mistakes/): safeguards and their limits

## Look up

- [Reference](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/reference/): all guides and configuration reference
- [Troubleshooting](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/troubleshooting/): setup, missing tests, limits and recovery
- [Skills](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/skills/): skill reference
- [Parallel rounds](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/parallel-rounds/): round mechanics
- [Configuration](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/reference/config-options/): every setting
